dialogue.instruction: Chatea con el Minero Max sobre los objetos del juego. Elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno.

turns.npc: Hi! Look in my hand. This is a pickaxe. What is it?
Good! Now I need to dig. Can you give me the shovel?
Thanks! Look, I have three apples. How many apples do I have?
Yes! And this torch is for the cave. Do you want a torch?
